svg.aria-label: Social rounds as a market map: scattered simulated buyers drift into three communities (Working Moms & Dads India, a WhatsApp running group and a subreddit) and follow each other. Live news is pushed in, “a competitor just cut its price”, lands on one person, and spreads as a wave through each community and across the bridges between them, while people reply: still not paying upfront, mine just got cheaper, price war incoming. Replies are illustrative.

svg.text: People join communities, follow each other, then react to what you push in.

g.text: Live news pushed in: “a competitor just cut its price”

svg.text: Community names and the news line are the README's examples; replies illustrative.
